sidebar.deleteResearchBody: This removes the research session's conversation. The workspace “{workspace}” keeps its sources, notes and findings.
sidebar.deleteChatBody: This removes the chat, its history and its workspace (including any local commits in it). Nothing was pushed from it.
access.clipboardError: The clipboard could not be read here: paste into the field instead.
access.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard is empty — copy your access link or token first.
access.title: Sign in to Orbit Web
access.lead: This Orbit Web is reachable from the internet, so it asks for its access token first. Then you sign in with your Orbit username and password.
access.step1: Enter this Orbit Web's access token
access.tokenHint: The token you were given with the link to this Orbit Web (made when it was deployed). Copied the access link? Paste takes it and goes on — and an opened link ending in #access=… needs nothing at all.
access.step2: Sign in with your Orbit username and password
access.step2Hint: Opens once the access token is accepted. Signing in to Orbit starts no AI provider's sign-in.
changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.lead: Welcome, {name}. Your password was set for you, so it must be changed before Orbit opens.
sharedChat.subtitle: · a shared chat
sharedChat.notShared: This chat is not shared, or no longer: the link may be wrong, or its owner stopped sharing it.
sharedChat.toolsByTitleOnly: · tools shown by their title only
sharedChat.footer: A read-only snapshot of this conversation, as it was when it was shared: it does not change as the chat goes on.
signIn.forgotLead: An operator issues a new one-time code on the server:
signIn.setupCodeStandingHint: This installation's standing setup code (ORBIT_WEB_SETUP_CODE), filled in for you: it makes the first administrator only.
signIn.setupCodeOneTimeHint: Printed on the server by node dist/cli/governance.js owner setup-code — valid for 30 minutes, and used once.
signIn.usernameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter.
signIn.timezoneHint: The default of your schedules. It starts as this browser's.
signIn.contactEmailHint: Optional. It stays unverified until Orbit can send mail.
signIn.setupLead: Create the first administrator of this installation. You connect Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity afterwards, in Settings → AI Connections.
signIn.signInLead: Sign in with your Orbit username and password. This is Orbit's own sign-in: no AI provider is asked, and none is started.
models.fallbackDetail: This connection's CLI could not be asked which models it may use: its fallback list is shown, and the CLI decides.
